issues.body: `_pins()` records a workflow even when a matched wasm-pack action block has zero `version:` lines, while `test_single_version_across_workflows()` flattens only the values that exist. For example, deleting `version:` from the ci.yml action leaves `ci.yml` present (so the anti-vacuity test passes) and leaves the distinct set as `{"v0.15.0"}` from js.yml (so the equality test also passes). Thus the regression this test is intended to prevent can recur as an unpinned/default-version CI lane without making the test red.
issues.fix_hint: Validate every matched action block has exactly one non-empty exact version before comparing versions (for example, retain per-step entries and assert `len(versions) == 1` for each block). Add a mutation-style test or otherwise demonstrate that removing ci.yml's `version:` causes this suite to fail.
issues.title: Repo-wide version test permits action steps with no version

verdict.summary: The workflow pin update itself is consistent, but the new repo-wide regression test is vacuous for a key failure mode: an action step can omit its version input and still satisfy the single-distinct-version assertion. Because the stated property is that every wasm-pack action requests the same explicit version, the test does not completely enforce the claimed invariant.
